meta.title: Raise a "New Activity" purchase intake request and trigger its approval workflow
gaps: Navigate to the Intake page and click Create Request
Enter the request title and select the New Activity condition
Advance through Basic Details and Details Page
Select currency and fill custom fields
Search and select a product, enter quantity, choose unit of measure, and select delivery location
Review and confirm the approval chain
Submit the intake and verify that its approval workflow has started
